description: This file contains unit tests for the PDFsharp library, focusing on PDF page box properties, drawing operations, and document creation.

classes.name: BasicTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods to verify PDF page box properties, drawing functions, and document creation in the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: Create_Hello_World_BasicTests
methods.description: Creates a PDF document, draws shapes and text, saves, and displays it; tests basic PDF creation and drawing.

methods.name: Create_CropBox_BasicTests
methods.description: Creates a PDF page, manipulates and tests various crop boxes, draws shapes and text, then saves and displays the document.

methods.name: Create_all_boxes_BasicTests
methods.description: Creates a PDF page, investigates all standard box types (MediaBox, CropBox, ArtBox, BleedBox, TrimBox), performs drawing, and saves the document.
